title: GC–EI Annotation Reliability Tool
description: Software for uncertainty-aware GC–EI–MS library annotation. The tool reports connectivity-level candidates, predicted top-1 correctness, 90% conformal candidate sets, empirical 5% and 10% target-error decisions, and optional Kovats RI-assisted scoring.

creators.name: Zothantluanga, James H.
